quarterly_data.quarter: Constellation Energy press release: Constellation Completes Sale of Brazos Valley Energy Center (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Constellation announced on Oct. 14, 2026 that it has completed the sale of the Brazos Valley Energy Center to LS Power: a 606-megawatt natural gas-fired combined-cycle facility outside Houston operating in the ERCOT market, divested under its agreement with the U.S. Department of Justice related to the Calpine acquisition (closed Jan. 7, 2026). The previously announced sale of approximately 4.4 gigawatts of predominantly natural gas-fired generation assets in Delaware and Pennsylvania to LS Power (Bethlehem, York 1, York 2, Hay Road and Edge Moor) is expected to close by the end of 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
quarterly_data.figure: 606 MW Brazos Valley sale completed; approximately 4.4 gigawatts PJM asset sale expected to close by end of 2026
